name: ling
description: Desktop and Web workspace for the Pi coding agent

scripts.dev: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:host && pnpm --filter @ling/desktop dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:host && node packages/host/dist/index.js --app-root=. --resources-dir=. --static-dir=apps/web/dist
scripts.build: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:host && pnpm --filter @ling/desktop build
scripts.package: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:host && pnpm --filter @ling/desktop package
scripts.check-types: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && pnpm --filter @ling/desktop check-types
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check-types && pnpm test
